_provenance: Hand-authored by a Claude subagent from the pilot prose alone, blind to any translator output, 2026-09-23.

rules.condition: Is self's hp below 25% of max hp?

criteria.true: no way to survive a follow-up hit, a dead mage is a silent one, no exceptions

rules.condition: Is any visible enemy bearbot inside melee/attack range of me — i.e. am I the closest thing to them?

criteria.true: already losing this exchange, leave immediately
criteria.false: still holding safe distance, nothing crowding me

rules.condition: Is Chord off cooldown with a visible enemy or minion cluster within its long range?

criteria.true: throw it now at the densest cluster, don't wait for a perfect moment
criteria.false: nothing in range yet, or already on cooldown

rules.condition: Is a visible enemy bearbot within basic-attack range, with Chord on cooldown, and I'm not in melee with it?

criteria.true: Chord is down — basic attack is the second option, never melee
criteria.false: no safe in-range target for a basic attack
